related.title: UMTS WCDMA：擴頻增益與資料率
related.titleEn: UMTS WCDMA: spreading gain and data rate
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付物能重現 48 kbit/s 與 36 kbit/s，保留失敗情境且每個通過判定有明確門檻；需分開列出模型未涵蓋的實際系統驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The artifacts must reproduce 48 kbit/s and 36 kbit/s, preserve failing scenarios and attach a threshold to each pass decision; list actual-system validation outside this model separately.
related.difference: 能推導並解釋250000 symbol/s與62500 symbol/s，建立wcdma_chips.csv、相關峰紀錄、SF速率表，並完成以下驗收：至少100 ksymbol/s需求不接受SF64；若SF16不滿足干擾條件，需降低需求或改善功率控制。
related.differenceEn: Derive and explain 250000 symbol/s and 62500 symbol/s; create wcdma_chips.csv, correlation-peak records and SF/rate table; apply this acceptance decision: A100 ksymbol/s target rejects SF64; if SF16 fails interference constraints, reduce demand or improve power control.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從原理 分配給封包的時槽受終端能力與方向切換約束；單槽有效率乘槽數只是固定條件模型。 展開基準式 12*4；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：建立8槽配置圖並標UL/DL/空閒，逐筆累加淨資料；不將編碼前符元率當12 kbit/s。 將兩條推導一起存入 gprs_slot_map.csv、能力假設、淨位元帳本。

從原理 固定chip rate下，符元率與spreading factor成反比；10log10(SF)是理想處理增益指標，不含多使用者干擾。 展開基準式 4000000/16；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：將各符元率乘SF回到4 Mchip/s；畫每個符元含16或64 chip的區塊。 將兩條推導一起存入 wcdma_chips.csv、相關峰紀錄、SF速率表。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Starting from Packet timeslots are constrained by terminal capability and direction switching; per-slot goodput times slot count is only a fixed-condition model., expand baseline expression 12*4; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Draw eight slots labeled UL/DL/idle and sum useful bits; do not confuse the12 kbit/s assumption with uncoded symbol rate. Save both derivations with gprs_slot_map.csv, capability assumptions and useful-bit ledger.

Starting from At fixed chip rate, symbol rate scales inversely with spreading factor;10log10(SF) is an ideal processing-gain indicator excluding multiuser interference., expand baseline expression 4000000/16; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Multiply symbol rate by SF to recover4 Mchip/s and draw16/64-chip symbol blocks. Save both derivations with wcdma_chips.csv, correlation-peak records and SF/rate table.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 5G NR TDD：上下行比例與保護開銷
related.titleEn: 5G NR TDD: downlink/uplink shares and guard overhead
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付物能重現 48 kbit/s 與 36 kbit/s，保留失敗情境且每個通過判定有明確門檻；需分開列出模型未涵蓋的實際系統驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The artifacts must reproduce 48 kbit/s and 36 kbit/s, preserve failing scenarios and attach a threshold to each pass decision; list actual-system validation outside this model separately.
related.difference: 能推導並解釋70 Mbit/s downlink與50 Mbit/s downlink，建立tdd_pattern.csv、雙方向需求表、保護區間圖，並完成以下驗收：需求DL60/UL15時第一組可行而第二不可；另設需求DL45/UL30時第二組可行而第一不可，沒有普遍最佳配比。
related.differenceEn: Derive and explain 70 Mbit/s downlink and 50 Mbit/s downlink; create tdd_pattern.csv, bidirectional demand table and guard intervals; apply this acceptance decision: For DL60/UL15 the first passes and second fails; a separate DL45/UL30 demand makes only the second pass, so no ratio is universally best.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從原理 分配給封包的時槽受終端能力與方向切換約束；單槽有效率乘槽數只是固定條件模型。 展開基準式 12*4；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：建立8槽配置圖並標UL/DL/空閒，逐筆累加淨資料；不將編碼前符元率當12 kbit/s。 將兩條推導一起存入 gprs_slot_map.csv、能力假設、淨位元帳本。
從原理 TDD共用時間資源，方向切換保護與UL/DL分配皆消耗時槽；不能把全時間PHY率同時給上下行。 展開基準式 100*7/10；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：把DL、UL、guard三者比例相加為1；分別計UL20與40 Mbit/s並保留方向標籤。 將兩條推導一起存入 tdd_pattern.csv、雙方向需求表、保護區間圖。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Starting from Packet timeslots are constrained by terminal capability and direction switching; per-slot goodput times slot count is only a fixed-condition model., expand baseline expression 12*4; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Draw eight slots labeled UL/DL/idle and sum useful bits; do not confuse the12 kbit/s assumption with uncoded symbol rate. Save both derivations with gprs_slot_map.csv, capability assumptions and useful-bit ledger.

Starting from TDD shares time resources; switching guards and UL/DL allocation consume slots, so both directions cannot receive full-time PHY rate simultaneously., expand baseline expression 100*7/10; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Sum DL, UL and guard fractions to1; independently compute UL20 and40 Mbit/s and retain direction labels. Save both derivations with tdd_pattern.csv, bidirectional demand table and guard intervals.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
